Payout of 8 July is short ₹775.98.
The bank credited ₹1,14,518.10 against an expected ₹1,15,294.08. 19 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000055 of ₹775.98, issued 27 July against payment pay_000515. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000055 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000055 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
